Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a liaison for community-based and faith-based social service organizations that receive no public funds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to communitybased and faithbased social servicesorganizations; and adding a new section to chapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary shall designate a person within each of thedepartment's administrative regions to serve as a liaison forcommunitybased and faithbased social services organizations that donot receive funding directly from the state. The liaison shall beavailable to such organizations for the purpose of: (a) Providing information as it relates to opportunities for suchorganizations to cooperate with the department in providing communityservices throughout the state; (b) Identifying areas of need that are not currently being met inthe state that communitybased and faithbased social servicesorganizations that do not receive funding directly from the state mayprovide; (c) Coordinating efforts to promote involvement of communitybased p. 1 HB 2550and faithbased social service organizations that do not receivefunding directly from the state in providing community services. (2) The department shall achieve the purposes of this sectionthrough existing resources.
